outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic gene/operon map, not a data plot, so individual data points are not applicable.
The scatter plot in B shows mean ± SEM together with individual gray dots for each biological replicate, as also stated in the caption ('individual values indicated by gray dots').
Same plot format as B: mean ± SEM bars with individual gray data points overlaid for each strain.
Same plot format as B/C: mean ± SEM bars with individual gray data points overlaid for each strain.

The growth curve shows only a single symbol (mean) with a vertical SEM error bar at each time point for each strain/condition (n=3 biological replicates per the caption); the individual replicate values are not plotted.
As in E, only mean ± SEM symbols are plotted at each time point; the three underlying biological replicate values are not shown individually.
As in E/F, only mean ± SEM symbols are plotted per time point for each strain; individual replicate data points are not displayed.
As in E-G, only mean ± SEM symbols are shown at each time point; the individual biological replicate measurements behind the means are not plotted.
